state.name: X
state.description: global position of the centre of gravity, x

state.name: Y
state.description: global position of the centre of gravity, y

state.name: Ux
state.description: body-frame longitudinal velocity at the centre of gravity

state.name: Uy
state.description: body-frame lateral velocity at the centre of gravity

input.name: Fx
input.description: total longitudinal tire force, positive drive, negative brake

vehicle.description: Project Chrono sedan (chrono_models Sedan_Vehicle) on PAC2002 tires 245/40 R18; written by identify_chrono

sources.chrono: read from the Chrono model at rest
sources.identified: from a manoeuvre driven in Chrono (see plant/identify_chrono.cpp)

Izz.description: yaw inertia about the centre of mass

a.description: centre of mass to front axle

b.description: centre of mass to rear axle

C_alpha_f.description: front axle cornering stiffness; Fiala fit to steering ramps at 10, 14, 18, 22 m/s on ground 0.9 (scripts/fit_chrono_tires.py)

C_alpha_r.description: rear axle cornering stiffness; Fiala fit to steering ramps at 10, 14, 18, 22 m/s on ground 0.9 (scripts/fit_chrono_tires.py)

mu.description: peak friction of the rear tires on ground of coefficient 0.9 (the dry road); Fiala fit to steering ramps at 10, 14, 18, 22 m/s on ground 0.9 (scripts/fit_chrono_tires.py)

grip_f.description: peak friction of the front tires relative to mu; Fiala fit to steering ramps at 10, 14, 18, 22 m/s on ground 0.9 (scripts/fit_chrono_tires.py)

drive_front.description: share of drive force on the front axle (front-wheel drive)

brake_front.description: share of brake force on the front axle (equal brake torques)

F_drive_max.description: peak drive force; Chrono's engine is not used

F_brake_max.description: four brakes at 2000 N m over the tire radius

P_max.description: drive power; Chrono's engine is not used

CdA.description: drag coefficient times frontal area, applied to the Chrono chassis

delta_max.description: road-wheel angle at full steering input

Ux_min.description: slip-angle denominator guard; the model is meant for Ux > 3
